hook: HC takes up newborn-unit fire and hospital roof collapse
hook_b: HC takes up newborn-unit fire and hospital roof collapse
tldr: The Telangana High Court took suo motu cognisance of the October SNCU fire at RIMS Adilabad and the September roof collapse at MGM Warangal.

beats.what: A bench of Acting Chief Justice P Sam Koshy and Justice Suddala Chalapathi Rao heard the PIL on Nov 5, per TOI.
beats.why: The petition says the incidents expose gaps in safety inspections, maintenance and emergency systems in government hospitals.
beats.care: Government hospitals serve lakhs of patients; the court could order safety audits across them.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The petitioner seeks fire, electrical and structural safety reports and a time-bound corrective plan for all govt hospitals.

cards.q: What should a hospital safety probe focus on first?

qs: How often are fire and structural audits done in Telangana's govt hospitals?
What would a time-bound safety plan need to cover?

facts.t: The HC posted the case to *Nov 16* after directing state and central govts to file counters.

steps.e: Roof collapse at MGM Hospital, Warangal
Fire at RIMS Adilabad newborn unit, 5 infants die
HC bench hears PIL, seeks counters

viz.verdict: Court now tracking safety in government hospitals

watch: The Nov 16 hearing, when state and central governments must file their replies.

sources.name: Times of India
sources.title: HC takes suo motu cognisance of RIMS hospital fire & MGM roof collapse

fact: Telangana HC takes up Adilabad hospital fire that killed *five* infants.
twist: The case began as an advocate's *letter to the Supreme Court*; the state and Centre must file counters before the *Nov 16* hearing.
